system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:23 UTC, WS-LMARTINS-01 recorded a 4648 explicit-credentials event targeting NWD\svc-render on PROXY-NWD-01, initiated by Meridian OpsAgent running as SYSTEM.
At 13:56 UTC, WS-NBLAKE-01 recorded a 4648 explicit-credentials event targeting NWD\svc-render on FILE-NWD-01, initiated by Meridian OpsAgent running as SYSTEM.

Use of svc-render from these workstations is inconsistent with the supplied inventory, which describes the account as a RenderQueue job on FILE-NWD-01; this is suspicious but does not by itself establish malicious activity.

The 13:23 event precedes the scheduled 13:30 password rotation, and the 13:56 event follows it. Stale credentials after rotation are a possible explanation for the later event, but the records do not establish that explanation.
The supplied 4648 records show explicit-credential use but do not establish whether either authentication succeeded or failed.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-coverage metadata reports that winsec and sysmon collection was unavailable on DC-NWD-01 and FILE-NWD-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the scheduled password rotation and the 13:56 event.
The supplied evidence contains only two relevant winsec records; it does not include domain-controller authentication outcomes or process and logon details from FILE-NWD-01.
The coverage metadata reports proxy, Zeek connection, DNS, and SSL sensors were available, but no corresponding records were supplied.
claims_not_established: Whether the two explicit-credential events resulted in successful logons, failed logons, or no completed authentication.
Whether either workstation use of svc-render was authorized or malicious, and who initiated or configured the OpsAgent activity.
Whether the RenderQueue job's password was rotated and updated correctly, or whether stale credentials caused the later event.
Whether there were additional authentication attempts during the collection outage.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover DC-NWD-01 authentication logs and FILE-NWD-01 security and process telemetry for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including logon outcomes and source details.
Obtain the svc-render rotation record and RenderQueue update or run logs to determine when the credential changed and whether the job was updated.
Identify the owner, installation history, configuration, and execution context of Meridian OpsAgent on WS-LMARTINS-01 and WS-NBLAKE-01.
Review proxy and Zeek records for activity from the two workstations around the events and correlate any connections with the recorded targets.
